correctness.rationale: All parents P_j are independent with probabilities i^α/W_{j−1}. Root attachment indicators A_j are independent Bernoulli(q_j=1/W_{j−1}). Starting with the genuinely prior innovation identity T_n−ET_n=Σ_{j=2}^n[1+(n−j)p_j]ξ_j, conditioning ξ_j on A_j gives Cov(A_j,ξ_j)=−q_j b_j, b_j=Σ_{i=2}^{j−1}p_i, yielding exact Cov(R_n,T_n)=−Σ q_j[1+(n−j)p_j]b_j. Nonnegativity of factors and j≥3 imply strict negativity. For α>0 Σq_j<∞ so R_n→R∞, and covariance convergence follows weighted absolute summability with univariate L² T_n/n→Lα. For α≤0 Var(R_n)→∞; Lindeberg independent Bernoulli CLT plus finite filtration approximation and small early root-indicator influence yield asymptotic independence from the path-cost martingale limit. α<−1, α=−1 and α>−1 asymptotic regimes are considered rather than conflated. α=1 rational-series telescoping gives the stated zeta constants and slope. Independent exhaustive weighted parent enumeration for α=−2,0,1 at n=4,6 exactly matches the finite covariance formula. Finite tests do not establish joint convergence.
